_source.what: Claude Code 2.1.322, live capture for #86 (probes/86/capture/ on feat/86-claude-permission-signal, b46fc09; REPORT.md there)
_source.lanes: listing (2 sessions), hooks (3), queue (1); claude-haiku-5-5, default permission mode
_source.times: ms relative to the step's prompt submit; hooks are receipt times (20-40 ms of python start-up included)
_source.polls: `claude agents --json` polled every 1 s by the lane recorder; start/end bracket each poll, and the state is read near its end
_source.screen: the lane's screen recorder: when a dialog was on screen (true) and when nothing was (false)
_source.sec01: metadata only: no session ids, tool_use_ids, hashes, inputs, responses or prompts. Agent ids are relabelled main/subN.

reportFacts.noticeAfterKeyTicks: a key restarts the 6 s idle check: 12016, 12043 ms (n=2), 18020 ms (n=1)
reportFacts.backgroundAgentLaunches: 17/17 general-purpose Agent launches ran in the background

B2-bash-approve.note: Bash on main, approved after its Notification; the tool is fast

B3-bash-esc.note: Bash on main, Esc after its Notification; no hook fires

B4-bash-slow-approve.note: Bash on main, approved after its Notification; the tool runs for seconds

C1a-bash-inert-right.note: Bash on main; an inert key at ~3 s moves the Notification to the 12 s tick; then Esc

Q1-ask-answer.note: AskUserQuestion on main: the listing reads waiting/'input needed' throughout; answered

Q1-slow.note: two serial Bash dialogs on main; the first approved after its Notification, the second mounts ~0.2 s later

Q2-sub-slow.note: two background subagents ask; main's turn Stops while sub2's dialog is still up (SUB2)

Q3-sub-esc.note: two background subagents ask; Esc at the first; main Stops while the second is still up (SUB6)

Q2c-mixed.note: main's Read dialog with a background subagent's Bash queued behind it; main Stops while the subagent's is up (SUB8)

OOO.note: main's Bash dialog (PPP) with a background subagent's (OOO) behind it; main approves, its turn Stops while OOO is up
